ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.18.3 is an AI stutter-reduction playtest for RimWorld 1.5. It keeps the validated eight-worker runtime and targets the measured JobGiver - GenClosest - Reachability/RegionTraverser long-tail chain. Per-Pawn reachability profiles are generation-owned instead of expiring every 180 frames: a 900-frame soft refresh keeps the old validated profile available while Region.Allows capture is spread across frame-budgeted chunks, with a 3600-frame defensive hard-age fuse. Stable spatial GenClosest reuse replaces the low-yield exact-IList candidate plan: supported temporary source lists can reuse worker-maintained PersistentMapSearchFabric sources after order-sensitive fingerprint lookup plus exact reference-by-reference membership validation; queries estimated above 128 live candidates fall through before speculative checks. The zero-yield permissive RegionHint builder is retired. Sampled ReachProfile parity/cooldown/fuse safeguards remain active, and Path worker results remain shadow-only. Workers do not create Jobs, reserve targets, or mutate Pawn/Thing/Map/Unity state.
